patch_description: Replace the fixed exponential moving average with a causal robust local-linear alpha-beta tracker. Each sliding window produces an endpoint-aligned weighted linear estimate, which removes much of the inherent averaging lag while retaining the current sample’s timing. A robust MAD residual scale adapts the tracker gain: stable/noisy periods are smoothed more strongly, while statistically significant innovations receive higher gain for genuine changes. The velocity reversal gate prevents small noise innovations from repeatedly changing trend direction, directly reducing slope changes and false reversals without delaying sustained real reversals.
